item: A stout sickle.
complication: A lord's tithe and a hard season drove you off; the debt stands.

item: A short bow and a half-quiver.
complication: You poached where you had no right; keepers know your face.

item: A felling axe.
complication: You felled timber under no charter; a warden wants the toll.

item: A net and a gutting knife.
complication: You owe the boat's owner a share, and he has not forgotten.

item: A smith's hammer.
complication: You broke your apprenticeship; your old master would have you pay.

knack: Stone, walls, and what is sound.
item: A heavy maul and a chisel.
complication: A wall of yours fell and a man died; the charge still hangs over you.

knack: Hides, knots, and foul work others refuse.
item: A flensing knife, and a stench that turns dogs.
complication: Honest folk shun the tanner's touch and will not seat you.

item: A pouch holding one Remedy.
complication: Some whisper your simples are poisons, and poisons do murder.

item: A tin cup, and a copper that always finds its way back.
complication: The watch ran you off once for good, and they know you by sight.

knack: Performance, lore, and winning a room.
item: A lute with one sour string.
complication: You lampooned the wrong lord in verse, and he has not laughed it off.

knack: Locks, pockets, and slipping a grip.
item: A thin blade and a set of picks.
complication: A guild or an old mark still means to settle with you.

knack: Rites, letters, and the names of the dead.
item: A holy token, warm near the unholy.
complication: Your order expects service, obedience, or coin.

knack: The dead, soil, and what should stay buried.
item: A spade, and a skull that was facing the wrong way.
complication: Many hold your trade unclean and will not have you near.

item: A heavy pestle.
complication: The village swears you keep false weights; the grudge runs deep.

item: A dozen candles that gutter blue near the dead.
complication: A fire in your shop ruined a neighbor, and the blame stuck.

item: A terrier, loyal and loud.
complication: You carried off more than rats once; a householder cries theft.

item: A pack of oddments, and a map to nowhere that keeps proving right.
complication: Your wares, debts, or name draw the wrong eyes in a settled town.

item: A long pole, and a coin a dead man paid.
complication: A passenger drowned at your crossing; the kin want an answer.

knack: Fire, smoke, and the deep wood.
item: A tinderbox that never fails, once.
complication: You burned wood that was not yours; the lord's men took note.

item: A notched sword too big for you, once your father's.
complication: The company that raised you blames your line for an old disgrace.
